---
title: "Typst image attributes: sizes, alt text precedence, inline box"
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrors: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - '#box\(image\("penrose\.svg", width: 1\.0416\d*in\)\)'
          - '#box\(image\("penrose\.svg"(?=[^)]*alt: "Unitless alt")(?=[^)]*width: 1\.0416\d*in)'
          - '#box\(image\("penrose\.svg", height: 0\.20833\d*in\)\)'
          - '#box\(image\("penrose\.svg"(?=[^)]*alt: "Percent alt")(?=[^)]*width: 10(\.0)?%)'
          - '#box\(image\("penrose\.svg"(?=[^)]*alt: "Fig-alt wins")'
          - '#box\(image\("penrose\.svg"(?=[^)]*alt: "Empty alt caption")'
          - '#box\(image\("penrose\.svg"\)\)'
        -
          - 'Alt loses'
          - 'fig-alt'
---

Unitless no alt: ![](penrose.svg){width="100"}

Unitless with alt: ![](penrose.svg){width="100" alt="Unitless alt"}

Px no alt: ![](penrose.svg){height="20px"}

Percent with alt: ![](penrose.svg){width="10%" alt="Percent alt"}

Fig-alt over alt: ![](penrose.svg){fig-alt="Fig-alt wins" alt="Alt loses"}

Empty alt with caption: text ![Empty alt caption](penrose.svg){alt=""} text

Empty alt no caption: ![](penrose.svg){alt=""}
